finalists.label: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy
finalists.why: The candidate has specific findings such as noncontrast head CT demonstrating a hypodense area in the right basal ganglia with mass effect but no hemorrhage and brain MRI revealing T2/FLAIR hyperintensity in the right basal ganglia and internal capsule with mild surrounding edema.

finalists.label: Encephalitis
finalists.why: The candidate has broad findings such as altered mental status, febrile and intermittently responsive, and noncontrast head CT demonstrating a hypodense area in the right basal ganglia with mass effect but no hemorrhage.

finalists.label: Cerebral vasculitis
finalists.why: The candidate has specific findings such as noncontrast head CT demonstrating a hypodense area in the right basal ganglia with mass effect but no hemorrhage and brain MRI revealing T2/FLAIR hyperintensity in the right basal ganglia and internal capsule with mild surrounding edema.

frontier_selector.why: The champion is chosen because it has the most specific findings that are not shared with other candidates, such as the progression of MRI findings and the presence of necrosis.

support_spans: Noncontrast head CT demonstrated a hypodense area in the right basal ganglia with mass effect but no hemorrhage
Brain MRI revealed T2/FLAIR hyperintensity in the right basal ganglia and internal capsule with mild surrounding edema
Repeat MRI demonstrated progression with new involvement of the left basal ganglia, increased diffusion restriction, development of necrosis, and new peripheral contrast enhancement
contradict_spans: Urine toxicology was positive for benzodiazepines and opiates
Repeat lumbar puncture showed an opening pressure of 30 cm H₂O, 1762 WBCs/mm³
